title: Proof length after reduction to three queries
statement: Let a semantic PCPP reduction assign a PCPP description to every Boolean circuit on each nonempty finite Boolean input cube, and suppose every verifier so obtained has a positive query count. For any such cube and circuit, the proof length of the resulting three-query description equals the original proof length plus the original query count multiplied by $2$ to the power of that query count and by the cardinality of the verifier's seed space.
hypotheses_covered: A semantic PCPP reduction is given
For every natural-number input dimension with a nonempty input cube and every Boolean circuit on it, the assigned verifier has positive query count
